banner.start: Set up your first mission — four steps, and you can stop at any point.
banner.resume: You were setting up your first mission. Pick up at step {step} of 4?

mission.title: What do you want to get better at, and why?
mission.why: The why is not decoration. Everything the app does later reads it — what to suggest, what to review, what to drop when you are short of time.

goal.title: What would it look like to have got there?
goal.why: Goals here are measured, not declared — so this asks for something the app can check rather than a feeling.
goal.goalTitle: What do you want to be true?
goal.hours: How many focused hours would it take?

resource.title: What are you learning from right now?
resource.why: Paste a link and the title, author, and type are filled in for you.
resource.manual: It's a book or something without a link
resource.name: What is it called?

focus.title: Do 15 minutes on it now.
focus.why: The habit is the product. Everything above is setup; this is the thing itself.
focus.intention: What does done look like for these 15 minutes?

done.title: That's the loop.
done.body: You have a mission, a goal with a real target, something to learn from, and a session running. Nothing here was demo data — it is all yours to edit or delete.
